finding: Eclipse Slash and Shatterhymn each caused a large, independently reproduced local interaction with Resonant Lance, but neither pairing produced positive Duskblade package activation in the preregistered discovery pilot panel. The strongest Duskblade panel upper 95% bound was 0.0181 SD, below the 0.25-SD practical target.
noFurtherRows: No held-out panel rows were run after the decisive discovery rejection.
No protected acceptance or reserve seed was used.
